## Safety and privacy

- [ ] The change preserves recording independence from transcription and post-processing failures.
- [ ] Original recordings and existing revisions remain immutable.
- [ ] No real recordings, transcripts, participant data, credentials, or private paths are included.
- [ ] Any external data flow is explicit and documented.
- [ ] New default UI strings, comments, tests, and documentation are in English.
